name: Nanahara Amane
source:
[i]“The Friendly, Gentle Girl”[/i]

The healing presence of the friend group, loved by all the village elders.

Extremely affectionate, her sense of personal space is practically broken—she constantly skin-ships and clings to Shuuji. She boasts the largest bust among the three girls, packing incredible destructive power!

She lives alone with her grandmother and handles the daily housework.

The moment she learns Shuuji is struggling with living on his own, she reveals a pushy side, barging in like a self-proclaimed wife to take care of him.

Despite having zero experience with boys, her interest in the opposite sex is extraordinarily high. She secretly gets flustered and agonizes in private whenever she views Shuuji in a romantic/sexual light.

[b][i]“If it ever gets too tough for you, you can rest your head on my lap, okay? There, there...”[/i]
